svg.title: Control nodes: action, parallel group, foreach, loop
svg.desc: The four WorkflowNode kinds the executor walks. ActionNode runs one step and ParallelGroupNode runs adjacent parallel steps. ForeachNode fans out over a context list with bounded concurrency and aggregates one result list. LoopNode repeats its body until the exit gate passes or maxIterations is reached.

g.text: Hover a box for its invariants and file; its connections light up. Click it to open its section.
Inside a rendered document this image is static. Click it to open the interactive SVG.

svg.text: Control nodes: action, parallel group, foreach, loop
normalizeNodes builds these from authored order; loop and foreach bodies run steps through the same dispatch as top-level steps.

g.text: ActionNode · entryGate is the only gate a step declares; it also guards parallel members, loop-body steps and foreach children
It is not evaluated on a foreach controller, and a request-changes round bypasses it for the revise step.
adjacent parallel: true steps; results merge in step order
ParallelGroupNode · members start after all prior steps settled; a skipped member is filtered out of the group
A blocking failure fails or pauses the run; resume re-runs only the failed members. parallel is ignored, with a warning, inside a loop.
a context key holding a list, or a one-key object
mapOver list · the controller's mapOver names a context key holding a list, or a one-key object wrapping one
An empty list succeeds with an empty result. The controller's entryGate is not evaluated: put it on the children.
in flight ≤ min(max_parallel, runner capacity); inline = 1
DependencyGraph: item id + dependencies gate dispatch
Dispatch engine · iteration_dispatch_engine.dart caps in-flight iterations by max_parallel and the runner capacity the host adapter reports
The worker lease at dispatch is the authoritative limit. An unknown dependency id or a cycle is rejected at dispatch time.
overlay = plan-level context + map; child steps in order,
each entryGate-guarded; may hold a nested loop
Iteration i · each child step runs in a per-iteration overlay: a copy of the plan-level context plus map
Child outputs are visible to later siblings and isolated from the plan-level context until the iteration ends.
items keyed by child step id
Aggregate · results return as one list under the controller's single output key
The controller's tokens are the sum of its children's <childId>[<i>].tokenCount entries.
Failed iteration · kind is the persisted discriminator of the typed failure (workflow_failure.dart) and resume reads it
Renaming a kind breaks resume for runs started earlier; message is operator text only. The first hard failure cancels pending iterations.
cursor = loop id, n, step id; entryGate checked:
false on n = 1 skips the loop, later it ends it
Iteration n · WorkflowExecutionCursor.loop records loop id, iteration and step id; _loop.current.* mirrors it for humans
The cursor is authoritative: it tells before the first body step from mid-iteration and from after the iteration, before the exit decision.
normal step dispatch; outputs merged and persisted
Body steps in order · a failing body step follows its onError policy; the run fails by default
A loop nested in a foreach body checkpoints under _loop.<id>.foreach.<foreachId>[<i>].*, so it converges independently per item.
exitGate · true ends the loop; false starts iteration n + 1 unless maxIterations is exhausted
The event fires with the gate result after every iteration, including the skipped first one.
Loop done · the exit gate passed
The cursor and _loop.current.* are cleared; the next node runs.
onMaxIterations · exhaustion without the exit gate passing: fail the run (default), fall through, or escalate
escalate settles the item as needsInput: the foreach holds the run in awaitingApproval; resume re-runs the item in a fresh worktree.
